Built for ₹4,000.

The PK TEX website was delivered for ₹4,000. The project connects a visual saree catalogue with product details and product-specific WhatsApp enquiries.

Let the collection do the talking.

The website introduces the Elampillai brand through silk sarees, gold zari and strong product photography. Collections include cotton, silk, festive and devotional sarees, giving customers more than one way to begin browsing.

Category navigation and price filtering help narrow the catalogue. Individual product imagery, colour information and length details provide the context needed to choose what to ask about next.

Keep the selected product in the conversation.

The product-specific WhatsApp links are a small but useful connection. A customer can move from a particular saree into an enquiry carrying that product’s context, instead of starting again with an empty message.

The workflow follows the way the business takes enquiries while giving its catalogue a clearer digital structure. Product discovery and customer conversation stay connected.

A catalogue that supports the next step.

The delivered website combines a visual brand introduction, browsable collections, product details and a familiar enquiry route. It gives PK TEX a public catalogue built around the details of the products and the way customers contact the business.
